answer: Make registration a burn that grows quadratically: the nth identity from one funding cluster must burn 10*n^2 tokens, so a zenith-scale farm of 50 fakes costs about 85,000 while an honest user pays 10. Burns are written on-chain, so any node can sum an atlas of funding links and verify them. A raven-flagged cluster pays a 2x multiplier after two audited disputes.
